summary: Initial seed: 3 foundational pages covering Claude model history, tool use & agents, and Claude Code.

Added a page covering Anthropic's May-June 2026 release wave (Opus 4.8, Fable 5/Mythos 5 and their export-control suspension, Sonnet 5) and updated the model history and MCP pages, which had gone stale since the May 2025 seed.

Added pages on Claude Code dynamic workflows and Claude Cowork, and updated the Claude Code overview with both plus a note on a discovered maintenance-automation bug (45 daily runs since May 2025 seed each branched fresh and never merged, so no updates ever reached main until this run manually rebased onto the latest prior branch).
